reason: I'd join with the café's link and use the free first collab, but I'm not paying ₹499 until I see real Bengaluru businesses on it that want Kannada creators. A beta with a small team sounds like it could be one café and a lot of empty listings.
objection: Will there actually be businesses on it, or is it empty like other apps? I also don't love that the pass means making promo videos for other businesses when I'm already editing reels at night after my day job.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing at least five or six real local businesses or brands on it actively offering paid collabs to Kannada creators my size, after my free collab goes well.
